projects.title: Solar PV Installation
projects.description: Rooftop solar system installed for a family home, cutting grid dependence and lowering monthly bills.
overview: This installation involved a full rooftop solar PV system for a family home, including panel positioning, inverter setup and connection into the property's existing electrical supply.
The completed system reduces the property's reliance on grid electricity, helping to lower monthly energy bills and improve the home's overall energy efficiency.

projects.title: Air Source Heat Pump Conversion
projects.description: Boiler-to-ASHP conversion delivering efficient, low-carbon heating for a semi-detached property.
overview: This project converted a semi-detached property from a traditional boiler to an air source heat pump, including removal of the old system and installation of the new heat pump, hot water cylinder and supporting pipework.
The result is a lower-carbon heating system designed to run efficiently throughout the year, in line with the homeowner's move away from fossil fuel heating.

projects.title: External Wall Insulation
projects.description: Full external wall insulation upgrade, reducing heat loss and modernising an older property's exterior.
overview: The external walls of this older property were insulated and rendered to improve thermal performance and reduce heat loss through the building fabric.
Alongside the efficiency improvement, the new render refreshed and modernised the exterior appearance of the property.

projects.title: Full Property Refurbishment
projects.description: Kitchen, bathroom, and extension refurbishment completed alongside an energy efficiency upgrade.
overview: This refurbishment covered kitchen, bathroom and extension work for the property, delivered alongside an energy efficiency upgrade as part of the same project.
Coordinating each area of the property under one team meant the homeowner had a single point of contact from planning through to completion.
